Title: Set up GitHub repo and folder structure
Label: setup
Description: Create repo with README, src/, data/, notebooks/ (preprocessing only), tests/, requirements.txt, .gitignore for data files.

Title: Set up GitHub Projects board
Label: setup
Description: Table view with Start Date and End Date fields, Board view (To Do / In Progress / Done), Roadmap view, link default repo, invite all members.

Title: Confirm eBay API license allows our use
Label: admin
Description: eBay updated its API license in June 2025 with restrictions on AI use of its data. Read the agreement and ask the TA or professor before using eBay data for training.

Title: Ask TA about pretrained image generators for synthetic data
Label: admin
Description: Confirm whether generating synthetic listing photos with a pretrained image model is allowed, given the no-pretrained-models rule.

Title: Define shared data schema
Label: data
Description: Agree on fields and formats for listings, users, and ratings so all three components read the same files.

Title: Download and clean Mercari dataset
Label: data
Description: Filter Home and furniture categories. Compute condition mix, price by category and condition, shipping share, and condition-to-price discount ratios.

Title: Download ABO furniture subset
Label: data
Description: Amazon Berkeley Objects catalog images and metadata for furniture product types. Record license (CC BY-NC 4.0) in README.

Title: Download zip code centroids and ACS tables
Label: data
Description: Census zip code centroids for distances. ACS vehicles available (B25044) and commute mode (B08301) for Boston / Suffolk County. Verify table numbers.

Title: Pull Amazon Reviews 2023 furniture subset
Label: data
Description: Home and Kitchen reviews and metadata filtered to furniture. Build user features from purchase history (average price, categories).

Title: Build listing attribute sampler
Label: data
Description: Sample category, condition, price, shipping, seller stats, and zip code from real distributions, keeping correlations (condition vs price). Furniture prices from Amazon new prices times Mercari condition discounts.

Title: Build simulated user generator
Label: data
Description: Profiles (budget, transport mode, style, has car) matched to ACS shares. Hidden true preference functions, some with nonlinear interactions. No demographic traits.

Title: Build LLM listing text generator
Label: data
Description: LLM writes titles and descriptions only, conditioned on sampled attributes, with varied real Mercari examples as few-shot. Mention flaws matching condition. Remove near-duplicates.

Title: Build synthetic rating generator
Label: data
Description: Ratings from hidden preference functions plus noise, reshaped to match the Amazon rating distribution and per-user rating counts.

Title: Validate synthetic data against real data
Label: data
Description: KS tests (continuous), chi-square (categorical), correlation comparison, text length and duplicate rate, and a real-vs-synthetic classifier test.

Title: Photograph and label real used items
Label: data
Description: A few hundred photos of real used furniture. Write a condition rubric (like new / good / fair) and label with two people to check agreement.

Title: Synthetic wear augmentation on ABO images
Label: cnn
Description: Add scratches, stains, fading, and tears at different severities to create good and fair classes. Plus flips, crops, and color jitter.

Title: CNN architecture and training loop from scratch
Label: cnn
Description: Small CNN in PyTorch on downscaled images (for example 64x64), 3 condition classes, no pretrained weights. Log training and validation curves.

Title: Baseline: logistic regression on color and texture features
Label: cnn
Description: Hand-crafted color histograms and texture statistics with logistic regression, implemented from scratch.

Title: Evaluate CNN on real team photos
Label: cnn
Description: Accuracy and confusion matrix on real photos vs synthetic test set. Report the synthetic-to-real gap.

Title: Export condition predictions as listing feature
Label: cnn
Description: Write predicted class probabilities per listing into the shared listing table for the matching model.

Title: Exact GP regression with product RBF kernel
Label: gp
Description: NumPy implementation using Cholesky. Kernel = user RBF times listing RBF. Predict mean and variance. Unit test on a toy 1D function.

Title: Tune GP hyperparameters by marginal likelihood
Label: gp
Description: Optimize length scales and noise by gradient ascent or grid search on the log marginal likelihood.

Title: Bayesian linear regression baseline
Label: gp
Description: Closed-form Gaussian posterior with user x listing interaction features. Equivalent to a GP with a linear kernel.

Title: Sparse GP with inducing points
Label: gp
Description: Choose inducing points by k-means. Compare accuracy and runtime against exact GP for M = 100, 250, 500.

Title: Random Fourier features comparison
Label: gp
Description: Approximate RBF kernel with D random cosine features plus Bayesian linear regression. Compare for D = 200, 500, 1000.

Title: Active learning for new users
Label: gp
Description: Ask new users to rate the listing with highest predicted variance. Compare against random selection.

Title: Two-tower neural network comparison
Label: gp
Description: User tower and listing tower with dot-product score, trained from scratch. Shows where the GP stops being enough as data grows.

Title: Matching model evaluation
Label: gp
Description: NDCG@10, cold start with 0/5/10 ratings, uncertainty calibration, learning curves (500 to 5,000 ratings), runtime.

Title: Hard constraint filter
Label: search
Description: Remove listings over budget, beyond transport radius (walk / transit / car limits), or too large for transport mode. Unit tests for each rule.

Title: Objective function and combination state
Label: search
Description: State = one listing per shopping-list item. Objective = total match score minus slider-weighted total price and distance. Reject combinations over total budget.

Title: Exhaustive search for small shopping lists
Label: search
Description: Exact optimum as the reference for measuring local search quality.

Title: Hill climbing with random restarts
Label: search
Description: Move = swap one item's listing for another eligible one.

Title: Simulated annealing
Label: search
Description: Temperature schedule, acceptance of worse moves, tuning of cooling rate and iterations.

Title: Slider rerun with warm start
Label: search
Description: When price or distance sliders change, rerun search starting from the current best combination.

Title: Search evaluation
Label: search
Description: Optimality gap vs exhaustive search, runtime vs list size, comparison against lowest-price baseline.

Title: Check-in 2 prep
Label: docs
Description: Short progress summary and a working demo of each component. Update the board before the check-in.

Title: End-to-end pipeline integration
Label: integration
Description: Constraints, then GP scoring, then local search, on shared data files. One script runs the full pipeline.

Title: Real-user test
Label: integration
Description: 10 to 20 classmates fill a short profile and rate about 30 listings. Use as a small real-world check of the matching model.

Title: Demo interface with sliders
Label: integration
Description: Simple UI showing the recommended set and price and distance sliders that rerun the search.

Title: Final results figures
Label: docs
Description: Colorblind-friendly plots for each component's comparison.

Title: Repo cleanup and README
Label: docs
Description: Setup instructions, how to reproduce results, data sources and licenses, folder guide.

Title: Executive project summary
Label: docs
Description: Use the course template, change the header from CS 4100 to CS 5100, fill all six sections including the individual contributions table.

Title: Walkthrough demo rehearsal
Label: docs
Description: Practice the demo end to end, with each member presenting their component.
